items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Yeah, I know, I played with Steve too, but he regular band was Piron.

ctx.x: I never met him, but I have some of his records.

Yeah, he left. He made some with- He was good. With Steve Lewis. Yeah, I know, I played with Steve too, but he regular band was Piron. Yeah, he played with Steve. Yeah, at Tranchinas. Yeah. And I played a long time at Club Forest up there with Duck Ones, many good fellas. See, where was the Club Forest?
Is that on Bourbon? No, I saw Metry.
